concerns.text: T016 mandates iterating over dimensions [, 64, 128, 256] (missing 16, syntax error). This violates FR-003 and Constitution VII which explicitly require the sweep range [16, 32, 64, 128, 256]. The task silently weakens the required dimensionality coverage.

T020 mandates generating videos for dimensions [16, 32, 64, 128, 256]. While this matches the spec, T016 (the prerequisite for generating the full curve) is broken. If T016 fails to produce the sweep, T020 cannot fulfill the 'full fidelity curve' requirement of FR-007.

T006 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and claims to create entity schemas in `specs/.../contracts/`. The 'Analyze Report' notes these files are missing. T030 (Phase N) requires these contracts to match generated data. Leaving T006 incomplete violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle (Constitution IV) by failing to define the data contract before generation tasks (T014-T020) execute.

T022 is marked [ ] (incomplete). It is the sole task implementing the 'segmented regression' and 'phase transition detection' required by FR-007 and Constitution VII. Without this task, the project cannot satisfy the core research requirement of identifying the breakpoint, constituting a dropped acceptance criterion.

T001 is marked [ ] (incomplete). It defines the project structure. The 'Analyze Report' confirms no directory tree exists. This violates the 'Reproducibility' principle (Constitution I) as the environment is not initialized, blocking all subsequent data hygiene and code execution.
